sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Tormented about her salvation. Consolation
aggravates. Profound depression of spirits. Constant
inclination to weep. Anxious; fears some organic and
incurable disease. Disposed to curse, strike, think ob-
scene things. Aimless, hurried manner; must keep busy.

[Cact.] F'cels full to bursting. Pulsations over whole
